POLICE_WARRANT_REASON_PH: Armed robbery at the Fleeca bank
POLICE_FINED: You were fined ${0}: a bill is waiting
POLICE_ERR_FINE_SEND: The fine could not be sent
POLICE_ERR_WARRANT: The warrant could not be changed
POLICE_ERR_WARRANT_REASON: Write a reason of at least 3 characters
POLICE_ERR_WARRANT_FULL: This person already has 20 active warrants
POLICE_ERR_WARRANT_GONE: This warrant is not active any more
ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: Which jobs are police and what they may do.
ADMIN_C_POLICE_DESC: On-duty members of these jobs get the police menu (F6).
ADMIN_H_JOBS: Job names whose on-duty members act as police.
ADMIN_H_MAX_FINE: Fines are taken from the bank and go to the job's account.
ADMIN_H_SHOT_ALERTS: Gunfire by civilians alerts on-duty officers through the alert script ai-core uses. Turn it off when that script sends its own shot alerts.
ADMIN_TAB_STATIONS_DESC: Where officers go on and off duty.
ADMIN_C_STATION_DESC: A duty point and its map blip.
ADMIN_H_DUTY: Stand where officers toggle duty and use your position.
POLICE_ERR_JAIL: Enter the minutes of the sentence.
POLICE_ERR_NO_PRISON: No prison is running on this server.
ADMIN_TAB_SIGHTINGS_DESC: Alert the police when a wanted player uses an ATM, a shop, a clothing store or a garage.
ADMIN_C_SIGHTINGS_DESC: A player with an active warrant may be reported when a place sees him. Warrants come from the MDT and / or ai-core's own warrants (officers issue them in the job menu, admins on a character's Players page); ai-core's MDT card decides which count.
ADMIN_H_SIGHTINGS: On-duty officers of the police jobs get an alert with the suspect's name, sex, vehicle and a map blip, through the alert script ai-core uses.
ADMIN_H_SIGHT_COOLDOWN: Seconds before the same player can be reported again, whatever the place.
ADMIN_H_SIGHT_DEFAULT: Used when a script reports a place the list below does not name.
ADMIN_C_SIGHT_PLACES_DESC: How likely each place reports a wanted player. ai-banking reports atm and bank, ai-inventory shop, ai-appearance clothing, ai-garages garage.
